messages:
clare: quick sync — we need to decide who can create vs enable automatic fallback policies in Console. The tricky bit is quota overrides + degrade modes (eg 'cached' vs 'quantized'). Design wants a compact chooser, security wants strict audit/approval. thoughts?
josh: +1 on separating "policy author" from "policy applier". Authors (product/platform) define the policy; operators (SRE/oncall) can stage/canary and flip the toggle. RBAC needs to be granular.
anita: agree. also for quotas: if a fallback increases cost, ops shouldn't silently bypass customer quota. suggest a policy property like `quota_effect: require_approval | notify_only | auto_apply` so we can enforce workflows.
marc: UI idea — when enabling a fallback that changes expected cost >= X% show a modal with estimated delta and require a justification checkbox. we already have a cost sim endpoint: `/v1/cost/simulate` so we can show numbers.
clare: modal makes sense, but oncall needs a "fast enable" path during incidents. propose a time-limited override flag `fast_enable=true` that creates a mandatory post-hoc approval ticket and an audit record.
linda: prefer TTL overrides rather than open-ended. e.g., `override_ttl=30m` that auto-expires and is visible on the rollout timeline. avoids approval spam.
josh: TTL + auto-expire + required justification text sound good. also make sure Console writes `origin=operator` and `operator_id` into audit so telemetry can filter those events.
devops-bot: Audit entry created: policy-change draft id=pf-202403-78 author=@josh status=draft
anita: another edge-case — fallback to a cheaper quantized variant can reduce output quality. we should have an "eval guard" that blocks auto-enable if recent eval delta > threshold, unless operator uses explicit override with a stronger justification.
clare: cool. so action items to capture in the spec: 1) RBAC: author vs applier roles 2) modal cost explainer with `/v1/cost/simulate` numbers 3) TTL time-limited overrides for oncall 4) post-hoc approval flow + required justification 5) eval-guard block with explicit override option 6) audit metadata fields: origin, operator_id, justification, ttl, cost_delta 7) Console should expose these in the rollout timeline and provide a single-click escalate to full approval flow. I'll draft a short spec and link it here. @josh can you prototype modal copy + wire to policy preview API?
josh: will prototype. I'll mock up copy and wire to `/v1/policies/preview` + show cost delta. aiming for EOD Friday.
marc: :thumbsup:
